$meta.title: The largest filers in each sector, by reported headcount band

measures.definition: Of the largest companies in a sector that file iXBRL accounts with a registered office in Burnley, the number reporting average employees in the band

$meta.table: iXBRL accounts joined to the register of 1 July 2026 (workstream B largest_companies.csv)
$meta.citation: Companies House (2026) accounts data, via workstream B
$meta.vintage: latest accounts each company had filed by July 2026
$meta.caveat: Counts only: no company is named. Headcount is each company's average wherever it works, not jobs in Burnley. Large employers registered outside the borough, the aerospace branch plants and the public bodies among them, are missing.
$meta.rules: No company or person is named. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
